active_directory.name: Create AD User
active_directory.description: Create a new Active Directory user with specified properties
active_directory.template:
# Create New Active Directory User
# Generated: $(Get-Date)

$Username = "{{username}}"
$FirstName = "{{firstname}}"
$LastName = "{{lastname}}"
$Password = ConvertTo-SecureString "{{password}}" -AsPlainText -Force
$OUPath = "{{ou_path}}"

Write-Host "=== CREATE ACTIVE DIRECTORY USER ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

try {
    New-ADUser -Name "$FirstName $LastName" `
        -GivenName $FirstName `
        -Surname $LastName `
        -SamAccountName $Username `
        -UserPrincipalName "$Username@company.com" `
        -Path $OUPath `
        -AccountPassword $Password `
        -Enabled $true `
        -ChangePasswordAtLogon $true
    
    Write-Host "✅ User $Username created successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Full Name: $FirstName $LastName" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "OU Path: $OUPath" -ForegroundColor Gray
    Write-Host "User must change password at next logon" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
catch {
    Write-Host "[ERROR] Failed to create user: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
}

active_directory.name: Reset AD User Password
active_directory.description: Reset password for an Active Directory user account
active_directory.template:
# Reset Active Directory User Password
# Generated: $(Get-Date)

$NewPassword = ConvertTo-SecureString "{{newpassword}}" -AsPlainText -Force

}
catch {

system_maintenance.name: Clear Print Queue & Restart Spooler
system_maintenance.description: Stop runaway printing, clear all print jobs, and restart the Print Spooler service
system_maintenance.template:
# Clear Print Queue & Restart Spooler
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: This script requires Administrator privileges

Write-Host "=== STOP RUNAWAY PRINTING ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# Check if running as administrator
$IsAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

if (-not $IsAdmin) {
    Write-Host "[!] WARNING: This script is not running as Administrator" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "    This operation requires admin privileges to work properly" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ""
}

try {
    # Stop Print Spooler
    Write-Host "Stopping Print Spooler service..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Stop-Service Spooler -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "  [OK] Print Spooler stopped" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    # Clear print queue files
    Write-Host "Clearing print queue files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $SpoolPath = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*"
    $FilesRemoved = (Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count
    Remove-Item $SpoolPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "  [OK] Removed $FilesRemoved file(s) from spool folder" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    # Start Print Spooler
    Write-Host "Starting Print Spooler service..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Start-Service Spooler -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host "  [OK] Print Spooler started" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    # Remove any remaining print jobs
    Write-Host "Removing any remaining print jobs..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $JobsCleared = 0
    Get-Printer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
        $PrinterName = $_.Name
        $Jobs = Get-PrintJob -PrinterName $PrinterName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($Jobs) {
            $Jobs | Remove-PrintJob -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            $JobsCleared += ($Jobs | Measure-Object).Count
            Write-Host "  Cleared jobs from: $PrinterName" -ForegroundColor Gray
        }
    }
    Write-Host "  [OK] Cleared $JobsCleared print job(s)" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    Write-Host "✅ SUCCESS: Print queues cleared, Spooler restarted" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "All print jobs have been stopped and removed." -ForegroundColor Cyan
}
catch {
    Write-Host "[ERROR] Failed to clear print queue: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Make sure you are running PowerShell as Administrator" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

domain_migration.template:
# Domain Migration - Restore User Data (No Duplications)
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: This script requires Administrator privileges

Write-Host "=== DOMAIN MIGRATION RESTORE (NO DUP) STARTED ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]"Administrator")) {
    Write-Error "Run this script as Administrator."
    exit 1
}

# Detect NEW user profile
$ExcludedPatterns = @('^Public$','^Default$','^Default User$','^All Users$','^Administrator$','^WDAGUtilityAccount$','^TEMP\.')

$NewUserProfile = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users' -Directory | Where-Object {
    $name = $_.Name
    ($ExcludedPatterns | Where-Object { $name -match $_ }).Count -eq 0 -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName 'NTUSER.DAT'))
} | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $NewUserProfile) {
    Write-Error "No valid NEW user profile found."
    exit 1
}

$NewUser = $NewUserProfile.Name
$NewProfileDir = $NewUserProfile.FullName

Write-Host "Detected NEW user profile: $NewUser" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Profile path: $NewProfileDir" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host ""

# Find backup folder
$BackupBase = "C:\DomainMigration"
if (-not (Test-Path $BackupBase)) {
    Write-Error "Backup root not found: $BackupBase"
    exit 1
}

$BackupFolder = Get-ChildItem $BackupBase -Directory | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $BackupFolder) {
    Write-Error "No backup folders found under $BackupBase"
    exit 1
}

$OldUserBackupRoot = $BackupFolder.FullName
Write-Host "Using backup source: $OldUserBackupRoot" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# Resolve NEW user's SID
$ProfileListKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList'
$Sid = $null

foreach ($p in Get-ChildItem $ProfileListKey) {
    $pi = Get-ItemProperty $p.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($pi.ProfileImagePath -ieq $NewProfileDir) {
        $Sid = Split-Path $p.PSChildName -Leaf
        break
    }
}

if (-not $Sid) {
    Write-Error "Could not resolve SID for $NewProfileDir"
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Resolved NEW SID: $Sid" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host ""

# Get shell folders
$UserShellKey = "Registry::HKEY_USERS\$Sid\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders"
if (-not (Test-Path $UserShellKey)) {
    Write-Error "User Shell Folders not found. Ensure the user has logged in at least once."
    exit 1
}

$UShell = Get-ItemProperty $UserShellKey
function Expand-UserPath { param([string]$p) [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($p) }

$DestDesktop = Expand-UserPath $UShell.Desktop
$DestDocuments = Expand-UserPath $UShell.Personal
$DestPictures = Expand-UserPath $UShell.'My Pictures'
$DestDownloads = Join-Path $NewProfileDir "Downloads"
$DestFavorites = Join-Path $NewProfileDir "Favorites"

Write-Host "Destination folders:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Desktop:   $DestDesktop" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "  Documents: $DestDocuments" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "  Pictures:  $DestPictures" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host ""

# No-dup robocopy options
$RoboNoDup = @("/E","/XO","/XN","/XC","/XJ","/R:1","/W:1","/NFL","/NDL")

function Restore-FolderNoDup {
    param([string]$Src, [string]$Dst, [string]$Label)
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $Src)) {
        Write-Host "Skip $Label (source missing)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        return
    }
    
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Dst -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "Restoring $Label (NO DUP): $Src -> $Dst" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    robocopy $Src $Dst @RoboNoDup | Out-Null
}

# Restore folders
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Desktop" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Desktop") -Dst $DestDesktop
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Documents" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Documents") -Dst $DestDocuments
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Pictures" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Pictures") -Dst $DestPictures
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Downloads" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Downloads") -Dst $DestDownloads
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Favorites" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Favorites") -Dst $DestFavorites

# Restore applications
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Outlook" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Outlook") -Dst (Join-Path $NewProfileDir "AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Outlook")
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Chrome" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Chrome") -Dst (Join-Path $NewProfileDir "AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data")
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Edge" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Edge") -Dst (Join-Path $NewProfileDir "AppData\Local\Microsoft\Edge\User Data")
Restore-FolderNoDup -Label "Firefox" -Src (Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "Firefox") -Dst (Join-Path $NewProfileDir "AppData\Roaming\Mozilla")

# Marker
$Marker = Join-Path $OldUserBackupRoot "RESTORE_COMPLETED_$($env:COMPUTERNAME).txt"
"Restore completed to $NewUser at $(Get-Date)" | Out-File $Marker -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ""

Write-Host "Restored to: $NewUser" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Reset Microsoft 365 User Password
# Generated: $(Get-Date)
# NOTE: Must be connected to Azure AD

$UserEmail = "{{user_email}}"
$NewPassword = "{{new_password}}"
$ForceChange = [System.Convert]::ToBoolean("{{force_change}}")

Write-Host "=== RESET M365 USER PASSWORD ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "User: $UserEmail" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "Force change at next login: $ForceChange" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host ""

try {
    # Create password profile
    $PasswordProfile = New-Object -TypeName Microsoft.Open.AzureAD.Model.PasswordProfile
    $PasswordProfile.Password = $NewPassword
    $PasswordProfile.ForceChangePasswordNextLogin = $ForceChange
    
    # Reset password
    Set-AzureADUserPassword -ObjectId $UserEmail -PasswordProfile $PasswordProfile
    
    Write-Host "✅ Password reset successfully!" -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ""
    
    if ($ForceChange) {
        Write-Host "User will be prompted to change password at next login" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    } else {
        Write-Host "User can keep this password" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[IMPORTANT] Provide this temporary password to the user securely" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    
} catch {
    Write-Host "❌ Error resetting password: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
}
